item.description: Bo Bichette entered Saturday's Grapefruit League game eager to see what he was facing at third base.

item.title: Baseball Hall of Famer Bill Mazeroski, known for walk-off home run in 1960 World Series, dies at 89
item.description: Bill Mazeroski, the Hall of Fame second baseman who won eight Gold Glove awards for his steady work in the field and the hearts of countless Pittsburgh Pirates fans for his historic walk-off home run in Game 7 of the 1960 World Series, has died at the age of 89.

item.title: Yankees’ Gerrit Cole has no interest in accelerating rehab after hard-throwing live BP session
item.description: Gerrit Cole said that he was “a little surprised” that he threw as hard as he did, though he noted that he’s pretty built up.

item.title: UConn men’s basketball bounces back with dominant 73-63 win at Villanova
item.description: The UConn men's basketball team responded from its tough loss to Creighton with a well-balanced 73-63 win at rival Villanova on Saturday.

item.title: NCAA MEN’S LACROSSE: Syracuse lacrosse upset by Harvard in first game since rising to No. 1 ranking
item.description: CAMBRIDGE, Mass. — Syracuse lacrosse’s first test since being ranked No. 1 in the country ended in a reminder that the climb and the crown are two different battles. The Orange kicked off their historic road trip on Saturday in snowy conditions against No. 14/13 Harvard. Just one week after knocking off then-No. 1 Maryland, SU got a taste of its own medicine.
